label: SMOKE fixture — PolitiFact verdict
summary: PolitiFact rated the claim Mostly True: 'accurate but needs clarification.' ICE acting director Todd Lyons confirmed training was shortened to six days a week for eight weeks = 48 days of training over a 56-day period (vs ~five months traditionally). Warner said 47; the documented figure is 48.
title: PolitiFact: Mark Warner on ICE training requirements

numerical_discrepancy.note: Warner said 47 days; ICE acting director confirmed 48 days of training over a 56-day period. Off-by-one on a substantively correct claim.
